models.name: todo_audit_events
models.description: System-wide audit trail capturing security- and business-relevant events such as registration, login/logout, todo CRUD operations, and unauthorized attempts. Each record optionally references the acting {@link todo_users} and the originating {@link todo_user_sessions}, and may point to the affected {@link todo_todos} resource when applicable. The table centralizes observability while keeping domain models clean. Rows are append-only in practice; soft deletion is reserved for exceptional redaction needs.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Acting user's {@link todo_users.id}. Enables attribution of who performed the action.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: Originating session's {@link todo_user_sessions.id}. Provides connection context for the action.

foreignFields.name: todo_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Target todo resource's {@link todo_todos.id} when the event pertains to a specific todo item.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor class that originated the event (e.g., "user", "system"). Used for quick filtering without joining.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: High-level category for the event (e.g., "auth", "todo", "security").

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Concrete action keyword (e.g., "register", "login", "logout", "todo_create", "todo_update", "todo_delete", "unauthorized_attempt").

plainFields.name: success
plainFields.description: Whether the attempted action completed successfully (true) or failed (false).

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Human-readable summary appropriate for operator review. Optional to avoid storing redundant text.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address captured at the time of the event, if available.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL at the time of the event, if available.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL associated with the request, if available.

plainFields.name: resource_type
plainFields.description: Type name of the affected resource (e.g., "user", "todo"). Present when the event is tied to a specific resource.

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: Opaque identifier of the affected resource when the event refers to a specific entity. Not a foreign key to allow polymorphism beyond current domains.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Event creation timestamp (when the event was recorded).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this audit row, typically equal to creation in append-only usage.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for exceptional redaction needs. Null means active.

models.name: todo_users
models.description: Authenticating user accounts for the minimal todo service. Each user owns personal todos in {@link todo_todos} (defined in another component). Stores the unique login identifier and the password hash required for authentication. Sessions are tracked in {@link todo_user_sessions}. Business rules: unique email per user; account deletion is hard delete in MVP; timestamps support ordering and audit expectations.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique login identifier for the user in email format. Used for authentication and account recovery flows (future).

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure password hash (never the plaintext password). Required for login verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions established after successful login for {@link todo_users}. Captures connection context (IP, URL, referrer), creation time, and optional expiration. Managed exclusively by authentication flows; supports many sessions per user. Composite index on (todo_user_id, created_at) optimizes recent-session lookups.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client establishing the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The request URL at session establishment.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referrer URL at session establishment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session end/invalidated time. Null means the session is currently active or expiry not yet recorded.

models.name: todo_todos
models.description: Personal todo items owned by a single user. Each record represents one task with a required title, optional description, optional date-only due date (interpreted at application level), a boolean completion state, and standard timestamps. Ownership is enforced via foreign key to {@link todo_users}. No soft delete in MVP (deletion is permanent). Overdue and due-today states are computed in application logic; no derived fields are stored. This model is the core business entity and is managed independently of sessions or audit events.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owning user’s {@link todo_users.id}. Exactly one owner per todo; no cross-user access.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required single-line short text naming the task. Business rules: 1–120 characters after trimming; no line breaks or control characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional multi-line details elaborating the task. Business rule: up to 1,000 characters after trimming; store as absent when empty.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional date-only due date. Store as a date-only value at DB level if possible (PostgreSQL DATE via Prisma @db.Date); otherwise interpret as calendar date without time-of-day in application logic.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status. false for not completed, true for completed. Defaults to not completed at creation (enforced by application or DB default).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the todo. Set at insert time for ordering and audit expectations.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the todo. Updated on each modification for deterministic secondary ordering.
